title: Biti: sem, si, je
description: The verb 'to be' in the present: all six forms, the dual, and the negative nisem, nisi, ni.

quest.story: Učiteljica Mojca ima nove učence iz Gorice. Pomagaj ji vaditi 'sem, si, je'. · Teacher Mojca has new pupils from Gorizia. Help her practise 'sem, si, je'.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: jaz → sem. Slovene usually drops the pronoun: Sem {learner}.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: ti → si. Ste is for vi (polite or plural): Vi ste iz Gorice?

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: One person (on, ona, babica) → je. So is for three or more.

exercises.instruction: Katere povedi so pravilne? · Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explain: mi → smo, vi → ste, oni and otroci → so, ti → si. 'Oni je' and 'ti je' mix persons. Nemčija = Germany.
Two people take the dual: {learner} in Maja sta. Three or more: so.
midva → sva, vidva → sta, onadva → sta. The village name Trnovo declines like an adjective: iz Trnovega.

exercises.text: Kruh ___ svež. (The bread is not fresh.)
exercises.explain: je → ni. The negative forms are one word: nisem, nisi, ni, nismo, niste, niso.

exercises.text: ___ iz Ljubljane, sem iz Berlina. (I'm not from Ljubljana, I'm from Berlin.)
exercises.explain: sem → nisem. Like imeti (nimam) and hoteti (nočem), biti fuses ne + sem into one word: nisem. Other verbs just take ne: ne grem.
mi → smo. Pri + locative: pri babici (at grandma's).
Polite vi → ste. Ali opens a yes/no question; in speech it's often dropped: Ste iz Gorice?
midva (two men, or a man and a woman) → sva. Two women: medve sva.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that you are not from Ljubljana, you are from Berlin.
exercises.say: Nisem iz Ljubljane, sem iz Berlina.
accept: Jaz nisem iz Ljubljane, jaz sem iz Berlina.
Nisem iz Ljubljane, jaz sem iz Berlina.
Jaz nisem iz Ljubljane, sem iz Berlina.
Nisem iz Ljubljane, ampak iz Berlina.
Nisem iz Ljubljane, ampak sem iz Berlina.
exercises.explain: nisem = I am not. Iz + genitive: iz Ljubljane, iz Berlina.
